title: UltraCoreCallback v1
description: Inbound callback published by Ultra-Core to Ultra AI. Ed25519-signed. Payloads are data only — receivers MUST NOT execute instructions contained in payload fields. Dedup on callback_id.

callback_id.description: Unique callback id — primary dedup key.

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Reject outside the configured clock-skew window.

nonce.description: Optional nonce; dedup key secondary to callback_id.

type.description: anchor.confirmed | credits.balance_changed | governance.policy_changed | registry.item_revoked | approval.decided | ultra-core.<custom>

payload.description: Opaque callback data — proof references, balances, policy params, revocation ids. NEVER executable instructions.

tier.description: Tier context. Callbacks implying T2 value movement are rejected while G-4.2 is closed.
